thread:
Alex B: Hey team — heads up I'm stuck at the airport, flight delayed. I'm currently primary for tonight's 22:00-06:00 window. Can someone swap primary with me for the night? I can still be reachable but won't be at my laptop for the first 3 hours.
Maria G: I can take primary 22:00-02:00 if Samir can cover 02:00-06:00. Otherwise I can do whole night if needed. :wave:
Samir: I can do 02:00-06:00. Confirming I'm happy to be secondary if Maria is primary.
Alex B: Thanks Maria/Samir — that's hugely helpful. Quick checklist: please ensure you check the incident runbook for high-latency P0s and the emergency rollback notes. Link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/oncall/runbooks/production-handbook
Oncall Bot: rotation-swap-request recorded (ID: rswap-497000). Please run `/oncall swap-confirm rswap-497000` once agreed.
Lee: small note — we have an open canary deploy scheduled at 00:30 UTC to the hosted API (low risk) — if you're primary you'll want to keep an eye on 500-rate and tail latency dashboards (Console > Routes > hosted-api).
Maria G: ack on the deploy note, I'll watch 00:20-01:00 window. Can someone post the quick grep for the kube pods health check I usually run?
Jamie: paste of the usual check:
```
# check pods in inference cluster
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | egrep "(CrashLoopBackOff|Error)" || echo "pods healthy"
# tail recent 500s
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/hosted-api -c api --since=10m | grep "HTTP 500" | tail -n 50
```
Samir: I'll be on-call paging for 02:00 onwards. If any P0 pages hit and you can't ack, jump to escalation policy 1->oncall->lead-sre. Also please enable prefix cache monitor in Console (Optimize > Caching > Prefix miss rate).
Alex B: FYI customer-impact: we had one API consumer report slow embeddings earlier today but that was a config issue and fixed. No current customer-wide impact noted.
Maria G: ok swapping plan: Maria primary 22:00-02:00, Samir primary 02:00-06:00, Alex will be secondary standby (reachable by call). Can everyone confirm? If confirmed I'll run the swap command. :thumbsup:
Samir: confirmed. :thumbsup:
Lee: confirmed, leaving a short handoff note in the incident channel and setting a temporary page rule for you two to escalate to lead-sre after 10m unacked.
Oncall Bot: temporary-escalation created for rswap-497000: escalate_after=600s, to=lead-sre.
Maria G: running the swap now:
```
/oncall swap --id rswap-497000 --new-primary "Maria G" --new-secondary "Samir" --notes "Alex delayed at airport, Maria 22-02, Samir 02-06"
```
Maria G: swap command returned OK. Took over as primary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 00:30 UTC to hosted-api. Notifying primary.
Alex B: thanks all — I owe you one. I'll watch notifications but will let you fight fires. If anything escalates beyond P1 call me.
Jamie: quick handoff tip — please add any alerts you muted during the night to the handoff note; we can reconcile in the morning.
Samir: noted, I'll pick up the 02:00 checklist and leave a short runbook addendum under the runbook link above.
Maria G: thanks — closing the swap thread. I'll post a short summary after the 00:30 canary check. :white_check_mark:
